scope: Real Chrome unpacked extension on local synthetic chat fixture only. No risk model or backend.

checks.name: popup injects collection only; no risk content loaded
before explicit start no messages
A/C exact alternating authors and group of three
no outside or composer text
B inheritance only explicit author group
D/E identical names not same account; repeated text retained
fallback matching requires sender time text AND adjacent stable anchor
F reload dedup; old messages removed from DOM retained
F old history sorted by overlapping DOM not first_seen
G reused DOM node keeps two messages
H quote separate from replying author text
I multiline emoji image and URL metadata only
forward content separate
J edit preview updated, not duplicate
J recall scrubs previous body in default JSON
K changed conversation stopped before mixed data
L unknown author/time explicit and not merged
pause disconnects and does not read new messages
resume explicitly observes visible messages again
M fast finalize flushes tail
loading bounded; not finalized silently
N memory byte limit pauses with explicit coverage
O panel hidden and input excluded
visibility excludes below-scrollport messages
700ms stopped-scroll feedback
scroll observed all 18, never auto-scrolled
capture scope recognizes actual ancestor scrollbar
snapshot stable after finalize
actual browser TXT download matches JSON snapshot
narrow viewport usable scrollable panel
no observation after freeze
zero backend/model fetch attempts in extension
zero page fetch/XHR attempts
CDP observed no POST or external HTTP request carrying conversation
no persistent conversation storage permissions
freeze disconnects capture observers intervals and listeners
clear removes snapshot and download access
unsupported region rejected without whole-page fallback
